title: BaselineRecord
description: NOT in the originally-named 31 contracts, added because .claude/ops/baselines/ was explicitly requested as a directory and needs a real shape to be functional rather than an empty folder — see .claude/rules/scope-control.md 'preserve a content baseline before writes'. Consumer: ops.mjs baseline record, called by implementation-engineer before a risky/large batch; git-auditor compares the current tree against the most recent baseline to detect scope leakage.
